info.name: Fini AI Agents Knowledge Folders API

description.content:
Public REST API for Fini AI, the self-improving AI agent for enterprise customer support. Manage agents, conversations, knowledge (sources, articles, folders), rules, tags, and prompts, and drive the agent loop via Generate Answer. Structure captured by API Evangelist from the published Fini API reference; not an official Fini-published OpenAPI.

 Name: Fini AI
